json.name: Mr. Ritesh Patel
json.background_quote: Mr Ritesh Patel is BE in Chemical Engineering with 24 years of extensive experience in the plastic piping systems industry, with in-depth knowledge of various polymer- based materials, like CPVC, PVC, PE and PP. He is having expertise in new product development, Research & Development (R&D), technical support, product costing and cost optimisation. Experienced in material innovation, product performance enhancement, troubleshooting, quality assurance, product testing, and compliance with industry standards.
